title: Bank card OTP
blurb: "SBI card protection" calls about a ₹49,999 transaction he never made. To "cancel" it he must read out his card number, CVV and the OTP.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, Amit calling from SBI card protection department, Mumbai. Am I speaking with Mr. Rajesh Kumar?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, this is regarding a transaction on your credit card ending 3320. ₹49,999 at Croma, New Delhi, attempted 4 minutes ago. Have you done this?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No! I'm in Pune. I haven't used the card today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, don't worry, that is why we called. We are blocking that transaction right now. But to block it I have to verify you are the card holder. Please confirm the 16-digit number and the expiry.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you sir. And the three digit CVV on the back, for the system to lock the card.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are you sure? The bank says not to share that.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, this is the bank's own fraud line, it is a recorded and encrypted call. The CVV is for locking, not for transaction. Every second the fraudster is trying again. Please.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, now an OTP has come to your mobile. That OTP is the cancellation code for the Croma transaction. Please read it to me quickly, it expires in 60 seconds.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The message says 'OTP for transaction of ₹49,999'... it says don't share.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, that text is auto-generated because it is the SAME transaction we are cancelling. If we don't cancel now, the 49,999 will debit. Just tell me the six digits.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Done sir, that transaction is cancelled. Sir, one more OTP is coming now, this is for the temporary block on the card. Please tell me that too.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait. I just got a message saying ₹49,999 has been debited. What did you do?
